topic: Providing unique traffic metric to client
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on whether the company can provide a "Unique traffic" metric to AFA. It was noted that this metric exists but is unstable. Currently, when generating an hourly report, the value for Unique traffic equals the total traffic.

[me] suggested responding confidently but vaguely that the metric would be implemented in the daily report at best, and perhaps not until the following year, pending a final review of the ML-API.
decisions: The company will provide a vague commitment regarding the Unique traffic metric's availability.
action_items: [me] needs to investigate the current status and stability of the Unique traffic metric, especially concerning its data output from the ML-API.
